description: Valid: SELECT from v_akademik_kelas (public schema, no prefix)
sql: SELECT dist_jumlah_a, dist_jumlah_b FROM v_akademik_kelas WHERE kode_matkul = 'IF1220' AND semester = 1 AND tahun = 2024

description: Valid: SELECT with aggregation and COALESCE from v_akademik_kelas
sql: SELECT COALESCE(AVG(avg_ip_akhir_mahasiswa), 0) AS avg_ip FROM v_akademik_kelas WHERE no_prodi = 135 AND semester = 1 AND tahun = 2024 AND avg_ip_akhir_mahasiswa IS NOT NULL

SELECT nama_prodi_id, COALESCE(avg_ip_akhir_mahasiswa, 0) FROM v_akademik_statistik_prodi WHERE kode_fakultas = 'STEI' AND semester = 1 AND tahun = 2024 AND avg_ip_akhir_mahasiswa IS NOT NULL ORDER BY avg_ip_akhir_mahasiswa DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT nama_dosen_gelar, COALESCE(avg_skor_pelaksanaan, 0) FROM v_akademik_statistik_dosen WHERE kode_fakultas_dosen = 'STEI' AND semester = 1 AND tahun = 2024 AND avg_skor_pelaksanaan IS NOT NULL ORDER BY avg_skor_pelaksanaan DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3

WITH top_mk AS (SELECT kode_matkul, AVG(avg_ip_akhir_mahasiswa) AS avg_ip FROM v_akademik_kelas WHERE no_prodi = 135 AND avg_ip_akhir_mahasiswa IS NOT NULL GROUP BY kode_matkul) SELECT kode_matkul, avg_ip FROM top_mk ORDER BY avg_ip DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5

description: Valid: JOIN v_akademik_kelas with evaluasi.portofolio (allowed schema)
sql: SELECT m.kelas_id, p.nilai FROM v_akademik_kelas m JOIN evaluasi.portofolio p ON m.kelas_id = p.kelas_id WHERE m.kode_matkul = 'IF1220' AND m.semester = 1 AND m.tahun = 2024

description: Valid: JOIN utama.mata_kuliah with kur24.cpmk (both allowed)
